title: library schema
description: A physical piece samples are taken on, e.g. a combinatorial thin-film library on a wafer (NREL HTEM's sample library): the sample set every set measured on the piece belongs to. Sample positions are given in its coordinate system. Anything not yet formalized goes in metadata.

physicalId.description: Identifier written on the physical piece; everything measured on it is joined by it

layout.description: Features on the surface of the piece

fabrication.description: The steps that made the piece, in order
